How the meet works

  1. Tap a lane to open it and read every card. The activities open when you finish reading.
  2. Finish every “Try it” activity in the lane. A wrong answer sends you to reread the highlighted part of the notes before you can try again.
  3. Swim the timed race: 4 questions in a row, 20 seconds each. A wrong answer sends you back to the wall to reread the highlighted part of the notes, then you race again.
  4. When all four lanes are done, swim the final lap: answer four short questions in your own words. Then you touch the wall automatically. Download your report as a PDF and upload it to Canvas.

Your progress saves on this device.
